name: FormValidation
title: Templates/Platform/States/FormValidation
summary: A standalone form that walks through every state a submit can land in, one story per state, on a single Create Variable page with no card around it: a heading, then `Field`s wrapping `Input`, `Select` and `Textarea` straight on the canvas in the form column, with Cancel and Create at the end of the column. Validation runs only on submit. An empty field takes the `required` state, a filled but wrong one takes `invalid`, and its helper text swaps the guidance for the message, so each field speaks in one place and there is no summary. Submit moves focus to the first field in error. A rejected request that no field owns raises an error toast with Retry and keeps the entries. A rejection a field owns, a key already in use, lands on that field and in a danger `Alert` above the fields, and never toasts. A successful save raises a success toast and clears the form. Its toasts go through `toast` into the app's one toast region (ToastPlugin, or one Toaster at the app root), never a Toaster in the page body. While the form loads, `Skeleton` rows stand in for the fields and Create is disabled. Every story is wired: press Create with API_TOKEN as the key to get the conflict, or any other valid key to get the success state. Below md the actions stack at full width. Its page-level parts are `PageHeader`. A rejection the server scopes to one section of a long form (a linked resource deleted while the form is open) is the FormError template (Templates/Platform/States/FormError). A page body for a create page: render it under the focused creation header (headers/creation-header), not in ConsoleLayout.

variants.name: ValidationErrors
variants.summary: Create pressed with gaps. The empty Value and Environment take the required state, the malformed key takes the invalid state, each helper text carries its own message, and focus moves to Key.

variants.name: Submitting
variants.summary: The request is in flight. Create shows its loading state, and the fields and Cancel are disabled so the entries cannot change mid-save.

variants.name: ServerError
variants.summary: The request failed and no field owns the failure. An error Toast says what failed and carries Retry, the lock is released, and every entry stays as typed.

variants.name: Conflict
variants.summary: The server rejected a value one field owns: the key is already in use. A danger Alert above the fields says so and that the entries are kept, Key takes the invalid state with its reason and the focus, and nothing toasts.

variants.name: Saved
variants.summary: The save went through. A success Toast names the new variable and where it is available, and the form is cleared for the next entry.

variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: The form while its data loads, such as the environments it offers or the record an edit form opens with. Skeleton rows hold the layout, and Create stays disabled until the fields arrive.
